content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from djmars404Sign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutedTagsdjmars404 and 3 othersOriginal audioMore optionsdjmars404 107wHistorically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) were established in the United States early in the 19th century, to provide undergraduate and graduate level educational opportunities to people of African descent. To this day, HBCU’s continue to be the leader for collegiate level education for African Americans. With over 100 HBCU’s in existence, every school has its own history and every student has their own unique story. New Era along with Clark Atlanta University alumni, Marshall “Dj Mars” Thomas, present to you 6 unique stories by 6 unique voices. All celebrating the history and importance of their particular HBCU.Starting TOMORROW, this collection will be available at www.firstdayoncampus.com. Join us as we represent, Howard, Hampton, Morgan State, Tuskegee and Southern University.
